caveats: No official player ratings; ratings are BBC Sport user averages, label them 'BBC fan rating'.
ESPN shot map labels Bayern as 'MUN'; treated as Bayern.
Bayern xG: BBC/ESPN report 1.77; the 19 listed shots sum to 1.78 (per-shot rounding). Use 1.77.
BBC report line 'Neuer faced just one shot on target' conflicts with BBC/ESPN stats (Atlético 3 on target, Neuer 3 saves): not used.

fcbayern.com ticker claims Atlético's last attempt before 49' was Barrios in the 15th minute; ESPN shot map has shots at 14', 20', 25'. Ticker gap not used; the 41-minute gap is from the ESPN shot map and is labelled as such.
